### A Great Plan
Author: Mary Southerland
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/girlfriends/a-great-plan-girlfriends-in-god-august-29-2013.html
Passage: Psalm 28:7
Points:
- People often attempt to dictate their own rescue rather than submitting to God.
- God created every person intentionally and has a loving, sovereign plan for each life.
- The Lord faithfully supplies the strength, protection, and resources needed to walk in His will.
- Even when circumstances seem dark and confusing, believers are called to trust the Plan Maker.
- Surrendering personal agendas to God releases His power and brings genuine joy.

### Wisdom from the Psalms 3/17
Author: Wisdom from the Psalms
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/wisdom/wisdom-from-the-psalms-3-or-17-552210.html
Passage: Psalm 28:7
Points:
- Difficult seasons and exhausting trials can feel like an overwhelming weight on our shoulders.
- Placing faith in God ensures that believers are sustained through every struggle.
- The Lord serves as our reliable shield and personal source of renewed strength.
- Experiencing God's deliverance transforms anxiety into relief, wisdom, and songs of praise.
